messages:
Evan T: Heads-up: Partner L requests a staggered EU->APAC rollout with an A/B quality hook and an explicit fast fallback. Need a compact plan: canary slices, flag names, rollback/rollforward policy, telemetry owner.
Priya M: Suggest micro-canary 3% random (2h) -> EU 25% (12h) with A/B 50/50 sample during EU 25% -> APAC warm and mirror for 24h shadow before APAC ramp. Block marketing for canary windows.
Ralph W: Tech: pin variant `l_partnerl.eu.q2`. Pre-warm EU pool + KV cache 30m before start. Flag suggestion: `pl_partnerl.eu.optin.v1`. Console can run A/B sample window of 10k requests.
SRE-oncall: SRE gates: auto-rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >0.8% for 180s OR p95 latency >2.5s for 3m. Quality gate: A/B semantic delta >3% worse -> pause and run rollforward path.
Ops-Kate: Ops needs hard kill-switch that flips to `model-global-safe` <20s. Also pre-authorize emergency +40% burst for first 4h. No promos during windows. Who owns kill-switch tests?
Evan T: SRE will own kill-switch automation; Ops runs staging rehearsal. Product owns telemetry appendix and customer signoff. Legal to approve sample sharing. Agree?
Priya M: Telemetry asks: per-tenant latency hist, token-cost delta, per-route 5xx, and up to 100 sanitized samples/day for first 72h. Delivery: daily for first 4 days, then every 72h for two weeks. Retention: raw samples 7d max, aggregates 90d.
LegalBot: Confirm DPA required for sample sharing. PII must be sanitized and hashes used for identifiers. Legal signoff needed before webhook delivery.
Ralph W: Rollforward plan: if A/B shows small quality dip (1-4%), we try rollforward to `l_partnerl.eu.rollfwd` (larger context variant) while keeping region routing. If delta >4% or rollforward fails -> full rollback to `model-global-safe`. Automation: disable failing slices -> enable rollforward -> run fast-eval 1k prompts -> continue or rollback.
SRE-oncall: Also add quarantine bucket for requests that hit degraded paths so we can route them to a safe variant and analyze.
Ops-Kate: Prewarm plan: script will run 30m prior and publish heatmap at T+6h and T+24h. Eng-Platform will provide token-cost delta csv.
Evan T: Draft launch checklist:
- Flag: `pl_partnerl.eu.optin.v1` (owner: Product)
- Canary schedule in Console (owner: Eng-Platform)
- Telemetry appendix + DPA (owner: Product + Legal)
- SLOs + rollback/rollforward automation (owner: SRE)
- Kill-switch + staging rehearsal (owner: Ops + SRE)
- Webhook + sample masking (owner: Eng-Platform)
- No-promo window enforced (owner: Ops)
Ops-Kate: Proposed cutover: Wednesday 07:00 UTC pending all signoffs. Please confirm by Monday EOD.
Evan T: Volunteers for staging run? @SRE-oncall to run kill-switch test, @Ralph W to run prewarm, @Priya M to validate webhook payload.
deploy-bot: checkpoint created: canary-plan/partnerl-eu-apac/1842500000 by Evan T
Priya M: Customer also wants a live Slack webhook that posts daily A/B score and latency heatmap to their staging. Eng-Platform: can you scope key rotation and masking?
Ralph W: Yes. We'll provide JSON schema, rotate keys every 7 days for initial 14d, and ensure PII masking.
Evan T: Final action items: Product draft telemetry appendix; Eng-Platform implement flag + webhook + prewarm; SRE implement SLOs + rollback/rollforward; Ops run staging rehearsal + cutover. EOD Monday for approvals. :thumbsup:
